Name: Junimatic Portal Workers
Author: PassionFruit0001
Description:
Junimatic Portal Workers 1.0.0

An independent add-on for Junimatic by NermNermNerm. Each active portal can have at most one worker, including multiple workers of the same profession on the same map.

FEATURES
All six Junimatic professions are supported, with their original unlock requirements. Task searches, original pathfinding, profession colors, machine reservations, raisin speed boosts and villager/scare rules remain in Junimatic.
Visible workers and off-screen automation both use portal slots. All professions share each portal's one-action budget per original background scheduling pulse. Temporary background networks exclude machines assigned to a live worker, so another portal cannot take that worker's machine.
Workers fetching raisins or returning home occupy their portal until they disappear. New workers receive unique NPC names so farmhouse duplicate-name cleanup does not remove same-profession workers.
No idle workers are spawned merely to reach a number: valid floor paths, available machines, ingredients, chest capacity and original work rules still apply. Abandoned portals do not count.

REQUIREMENTS AND INSTALLATION
SMAPI 4.5.2 or later, and EXACTLY Junimatic 2.1.6. Other Junimatic versions disable this add-on with an explanation. Built against Stardew Valley 1.6.15 for x64 Windows/Linux.
Exit the game. Extract JunimaticPortalWorkers into Mods, alongside the original Junimatic folder. KEEP BOTH. Launch through SMAPI. Automatic operation; no config options or Generic Mod Config Menu entry.
Original Junimatic: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22672
SMAPI: https://smapi.io/

CHECKING IT
Connect two active portals, a stocked chest and at least two machines with jobs using normal Junimatic floor/path rules. Allow the next scheduling interval; each free portal can send a worker to a different machine. Also check background progress after leaving and returning to the map.
Run jpw_check in the SMAPI console to see portals, workers per portal and overlapping machine reservations. Attach the complete SMAPI-latest.txt to a GitHub issue if something fails. Remove only this add-on folder after exiting to restore normal Junimatic scheduling.

VALIDATION LIMITS
Original delivery passed a Release build with zero warnings/errors, 47 core tests and 50 real Junimatic DLL contract checks. Actual Steam Deck gameplay and multiplayer behavior have NOT yet been confirmed. Those offline checks are not an in-game test. The delivered DLL is unchanged in this publication.

SOURCE, LICENSE AND CREDITS

MIT, copyright Luke. Junimatic and its original planning/pathfinding are by NermNermNerm: https://github.com/NermNermNerm/Junimatic
This is an independent add-on, not an official Junimatic release. No original Junimatic, Stardew Valley, SMAPI or Harmony DLLs are redistributed. Code and documentation were developed with substantial AI assistance from the requesting player's requirements. The cover is a utility illustration, not an in-game screenshot.
